item: Acknowledgments, references and DANS data availability
reason: Reference 40 thesis is immediate class-table primary, with refs31/39 antecedents and ref41 companion. DANS data accession is a dataset-intake pointer only; no CSV/XLSX/R ingest or supplemental dataset download claimed.

Explicitly mixes forest restoration and new plantations; neither native ecosystem history nor intended species establishes ecological active-planting family boundary. Abstract gives elevation 1200–2400 m.

Five criteria used: NDVI, NDMI, slope, aspect, elevation. NDMI is vegetation moisture index, not soil drainage or volumetric soil moisture. DEM source is USGS 30 m, product unspecified. Forest-management-plan lineage recorded.

Existing forest occurrence used to choose criteria, with 1300–2400 m versus abstract/conclusion 1200–2400 m. Existing healthy vegetation favoured here, while abstract targets degraded/sparse vegetation.

Raw NDVI, NDMI, slope, elevation and aspect maps are not response curves. Figure 8 green 0–10 degrees does not override prose selecting 10–30 degrees. Figure 9 final binary suitability has no reproducible NDVI/NDMI cutoffs or weights.

Aspect claim differs by moisture-demanding versus drought-tolerant vegetation. No named taxon invented. Results/discussion 1300 m minimum versus conclusion 1200 m. Regional observational filter is not a global establishment envelope.
No funding/conflict declared; generic literature data-availability statement, no independent field/survival validation. Retain all findings pending human scope ruling, no SRC/EV admission.
